acceptance: If retargeted: keyed overrides and bypass rules updated, a corpus diff lists every changed query, and affected published bundles are flagged or noted.
description: After #3379 the platform manifest is the single platform-to-dialect home. Athena and SingleStore keep query_dialect trino and mysql because benchmark code keys behavior on those names. Native dialects would give SingleStore :> casts and NULLS FIRST, and Athena its own dialect. Retargeting needs the keyed overrides and the lock-bypass rules updated. Owner decision.
